extension.description: Connect a trusted MCP client to this VS Code workspace with local authentication and session access controls.
view.title: Workspace Bridge
configuration.title: Workspace Bridge MCP
configuration.autoStart: Start a local read-only bridge when this trusted workspace opens. Edit and terminal permissions always require approval for each session.
configuration.port: Preferred local port. If occupied, the bridge tries the next 9 ports and displays the actual endpoint. Use 0 for an automatically assigned port.
configuration.allowedHosts: Additional exact HTTP Host names accepted by the local server. Empty by default. This does not create a tunnel or enable a public listener. Only configure names you control.
